draft.text: You came in because you have been having changes in your vision in your right eye.
You said you have trouble adjusting to dim lighting and straight lines look wavy.
These changes have been getting worse over the past few months.
We did not find any pain, redness, or floaters in your right eye.
You said you have not had any eye exams, like a dilated eye exam or an OCT.
You also said you have high blood pressure and are not taking your medication as prescribed.
You will need to schedule a dilated eye exam and an OCT to check your eyes further.
You will also need blood tests for diabetes and your lipid profile.

unverified_summary.text: You came because you have been having vision changes in your right eye.
You have trouble adjusting to dim lighting and straight lines look wavy.
This has been getting worse over the past few months.
We did not find any pain, redness, floaters, or other issues in your right eye.
There were no recent injuries or bright light exposure.
You also have high blood pressure and are not taking your medication as prescribed.
We do not know the cause of your vision changes yet.
More tests are needed to understand what is happening.
You will need to have a dilated eye exam and an OCT scan.
You will also have blood tests for diabetes and your lipid profile.
You should start taking your high blood pressure medication as prescribed.
We will talk about the results of your tests at a follow-up appointment.
